messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up: vendor is dropping off cupcakes for the team wellness table at 3:30pm, plus a framed print for the corridor. Also the volunteer handler is bringing a certified therapy dog for a 20-min visit. Can we print a temp badge and confirm logistics?
frontdesk: Thanks for the ping. We can print a visitor badge on arrival. A couple of notes: well need the handler to sign the pet policy waiver and keep the dog on a short leash. We'll post a small sign about the visit so people with allergies have a heads-up.
jordan: Good call. The cupcakes are marked "may contain nuts" 1: can we put them in the kitchen fridge until 3:25pm and label them?
lena: I can clear a shelf in the fridge and tape a "wellness cupcakes - do not eat" label. Also can someone grab small plates and tongs?
aries: Ill bring disposable plates & tongs. Also, where should the framed print go? It's about 24x36, framed glass.
frontdesk: We prefer not to leave glass frames on the floor. We can put it in the art closet (lockable) or the low oak shelf if someone can carry it upstairs right away. If fragile, art closet is safer.\ar facilities: I can meet the vendor at 3:30 and take the print to the art closet. Leaving a sticky on the closet door so frontdesk knows it's there.
jordan: Thanks @facilities. Could someone also add a "no nuts" sign near the food table? We had a reaction last year.
lena: I'll print a small allergen sign and stick it to the stand.
badge-bot: temp badge printed: "Visitor - Therapy Dog Handler" (expires 16:00).
frontdesk: For the dog: please ensure handler has proof of certification and recent shots. We'll offer a water bowl and a towel if needed.
aries: Handler confirmed paperwork via email; I'll forward to frontdesk. Also note: dog is small and non-shedding.
jordan: Awesome. Seating: short visit, so we'll use the lounge corner with a rug (less traffic). That keeps things calm.
frontdesk: Lounge corner reserved. We'll put a subtle "visitor in lounge" sign and keep the main walkway clear.
lena: I'll label the cupcakes and stash them in the fridge until 3:25. Plates & tongs on the table.
facilities: Print is in the art closet, labelled "Jordan - framed print". Key left with frontdesk.
jordan: Huge thanks team. One last: the vendor said they'd leave an extra box of promo flyers. Can we drop those in the marketing inbox at the desk instead of leaving them on the table?
frontdesk: Yes, we'll put flyers in the small inbox labelled "Marketing - flyers" and note where the print is stored.
aries: Quick poll: offer tea or water to the handler? :tea: :droplet:
jordan: water please
lena: tea thanks
frontdesk: We'll offer both. See you at 3:30pm, printing badge on arrival and posting the allergy sign.
